en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm pond or small lake bordered by trees and a promenade. Several rowboats are moored along the bank and one person is rowing a small boat in the foreground. On the right stands a round pavilion or kiosk with many windows. People stroll or sit along the waterside path, with buildings visible through the trees in the background. At the bottom left, a caption in cursive identifies the location.
